messages:
marta: quick async pulse — SDK quickstarts + sample app status. TL;DR: finished node quickstart draft, but mac M1 binary issue popped. What I did / blockers / today.

ben: nice. link the PR?

marta: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 — added step-by-step Node + curl example, and a troubleshooting note for common token errors.

sam: saw that, will review in a bit. mac M1 issue — do you have the error log?

marta: yep pasted below. hitting `dyld: library not loaded: @rpath/libonnxruntime.dylib` when running `npm run smoke`.

marta: ```
Error: dyld: Library not loaded: @rpath/libonnxruntime.dylib
  Referenced from: /Users/marta/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/@redwood/sample-app/bin/native
  Reason: image not found
```

tess: that usually means the prebuilt wheel didn't get linked. On M1 we often recommend the `--build-from-source` flow in the README. Did the quickstart include that fallback?

marta: I added a small note but not the full command. Blocker for me: need a verified minimal set of steps that work on mac silicon so we can mark the quickstart as M1-compatible.

ben: I can test on my M1 later today. If it fails, we can add a small bash snippet to install the runtime locally.

sam: also, the sampleapp's Dockerfile still references `ubuntu:20.04` base and fails on ARM build. We should add a `--platform=linux/amd64` mention for local builds or add multi-arch image instructions.

marta: good call. I'll add a short note under 'Building locally' and a GH issue to track multi-arch image support.

jordan: GH issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/128 — labels: docs, infra, help-wanted.

marta: thanks. Today I'll: 1) update quickstart with explicit M1 troubleshooting + build-from-source snippet, 2) add Docker multi-arch note, 3) address small wording bits Sam flagged in PR 492.

tess: FYI — docs-bot found a broken link in the old python quickstart (404 to sdk/python/old-setup).

docs-bot: Automated check: broken link detected in /docs/quickstarts/python. Suggested replacement: /docs/sdk/python/installation.

marta: thanks bot — I'll swap the link.

sam: pinging @ben for PR review when you test M1. If it passes, can we merge by EOD? We want the onboarding flow stable for the next cohort.

ben: will aim for EOD. If I hit the same `dyld` error, I can prototype the build-from-source command and paste it here.

marta: perfect. Blockers: none critical except awaiting Ben's M1 validation. Otherwise unblocked.

tess: small ask — can we add a one-liner in the quickstart that points to the 'known platform quirks' section? Saves folks a click.

marta: good idea, will add.

sam: last note — can someone add a test matrix entry for mac M1 smoke in CI (skip on mac runners if not available)? I'll open a follow-up ticket.

jordan: noted. I'll add it to the backlog and tag infra.

marta: thanks all. If anyone wants to pair on the wording, I have a slot 2:30pm PT. Otherwise I'll push changes and ping for quick reviews. :coffee:
